musicPools.note: One pool per stage. Rotation = random track pick at round start + re-pick at next bar boundary between rounds. All layers of a track start at the same ctx time so they stay in sync; layer gains are RTPC-driven (below). Keep every layer the same length/BPM or the crossfade drifts.

note_on_pantera_bank: Sampler MP3s in ~/workspace/king-mods/ are CONCATENATED samplers, not split clips. The manifest in king-mods/pantera-sounds-manifest.md gives per-clip durations for Set B (Tekken 2 grunts, 26 clips, owner-preferred 2026-10-24). Before this JSON is usable, split the sampler into 26 files OR add cue:[start,dur] ranges computed by cumulatively summing Set B durations in file order. Do NOT invent cue offsets — compute them from the manifest. Set A (classic) is the fallback bank; Set C is the single T8 death scream (2.529s). Clip labels (greeting/growl/roar) are NOT in the bank data — identify by position number only.

rtpcCurves.note_intensity_drivers: intensity = clamp(0.35*comboHeat + 0.35*healthDeficit + 0.30*roundTimerPressure), each 0..1. comboHeat decays over ~3s without a hit; healthDeficit = 1 - (ownHP/maxHP) of the LOSING fighter; roundTimerPressure rises in the last 15s. Recompute once per frame from game state — cheap, no audio-thread work.
